read.thesis: Dow's Q4 Op. EBIT fell to $33M (vs $454M a year ago) on 8% local price declines and downtime, with no capacity cuts quantified; supply discipline is only partly evidenced by the cracker idling in EMEAI.

utilisation.quote: Op. EBIT was $33 million, down $421 million year-over-year. This was primarily driven by price declines and lower operating rates

triggers.label: EMEAI cracker idled earlier in 2025
triggers.quote: lower merchant olefins sales in Europe, the Middle East, Africa and India (EMEAI) following the idling of a cracker in the region earlier in the year

triggers.label: Local price down 8% YoY
triggers.quote: Local price was down 8% versus the year-ago period and down 3% sequentially.

triggers.label: At least $2B additional near-term earnings target
triggers.quote: We expect these efforts to provide at least $2 billion in additional near-term earnings
